currentParagraphText: “Alright,” Jake said, still concerned. Seeing as Irin still looked a bit wobbly on her legs, he motioned for her to maybe come and take a seat in the living room, something she gladly agreed to as Jake allowed her to lean on him as he helped her in there.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: In fact, she leaned on him perhaps a bit too much, and from the way she walked, she clearly wasn’t as affected as she let on. Still, Jake let it go as he soon sat down on the couch with her, the succubus still leaning against him.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I’m perfectly fine,” Irin kept smiling. “I just need a moment.”
